mapper.sql: n.id, n.title, n.content, n.type, n.priority, n.status, n.publisher_id, n.view_count, n.is_top, n.publish_time, n.expire_time, n.created_at, n.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT , u.nickname AS publisher_name FROM `announcement` n LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = n.publisher_id WHERE n.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM `announcement` n WHERE n.status = 1 AND (n.expire_time IS NULL OR n.expire_time > NOW()) ORDER BY n.is_top DESC, n.priority DESC, n.publish_time DESC, n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `announcement` (title, content, type, priority, status, publisher_id, view_count, is_top, publish_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{publisherId}, 0, #{isTop}, #{publishTime}, #{expireTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `announcement` SET status = #{status}, publish_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 AND publish_time IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE publish_time END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `announcement` SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
